result.response:
The bug causing missing return validation errors on functions containing `try-finally` blocks followed by return statements has been identified and fixed.

### Cause of the Issue
In [`ControlFlowAnalysis.computeFollowNode`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/closure_14_group_b_fix/src/com/google/javascript/jscomp/ControlFlowAnalysis.java#L764-L771), when exiting a `finally` block to another enclosing `finally` block or handler tracked in `cfa.finallyMap`, the edge was created with `Branch.UNCOND` instead of `Branch.ON_EX`. This caused exceptional flow through the `finally` block to be treated as an uncovered normal execution path that bypasses subsequent return statements, triggering an incorrect `JSC_MISSING_RETURN_STATEMENT` warning.

### Fix
In [`src/com/google/javascript/jscomp/ControlFlowAnalysis.java`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/closure_14_group_b_fix/src/com/google/javascript/jscomp/ControlFlowAnalysis.java#L767), changed the branch type from `Branch.UNCOND` to `Branch.ON_EX` when creating edges to handlers/finally nodes in `finallyMap`:
```java
cfa.createEdge(fromNode, Branch.ON_EX, finallyNode);
```

### Verification
The failing test `com.google.javascript.jscomp.CheckMissingReturnTest::testIssue779` (as well as `ControlFlowAnalysisTest::testDeepNestedFinally` and `ControlFlowAnalysisTest::testDeepNestedBreakwithFinally`) now passes with 0 failures.

The patch file has been saved to [`nl_fix.patch`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/closure_14_group_b_fix/nl_fix.patch).
